title: Kehti thi sakina
body:
kehti thi sakina aao chacha
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
allah re mujh par jo ro jafa
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shumre sitamgar maahile shaar
hai zulm se uske chalni jigar
padte hai tamazhe subho masa
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maa phupiyon ki hasrat tum se kahoo
ya apni musibat tum se kahoo
har roz hai hum par zulm naya
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar bhi huye aankhon se niha
qasim ka bhi kuch paaya na nashan
baba ka bhi milta hai na pata
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dunya ki nigaahein hum se phiri
saydaniya sab nazron se giri
kya tum bhi huwe ho hum se khafa
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zindan ki wo girti deewarein
ranjoor dilon ki wo aahein
dehshat se jigar phat'ta hai mera
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam aati hai zindan mein jis dam
ghabrata hai dil mera us dam
chillati hoo keh kar aao chacha
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder bas rok apna qalam
majlis mein hui har chashm hai nam
hai josh pe darya matam ka
ab jaan nikalne waali hai
author: Hyder
